core_competencies.name: Communication & Influence
core_competencies.definition: Interacting with others openly and effectively demonstrating accuracy, transparency, and clarity.

1: Can express own perspective clearly and concisely
Listens to others and uses relevant questions to gather information
Explains and justifies point of view objectively
Body language is appropriate and consistent with non-verbal messages
2: Focuses on the issues and conveys the meaning concisely and effectively
Is accessible and gives others time to fully express their thoughts
Actively seeks to influence others before a decision is made
Prevents arguments and ensures focus is maintained throughout discussions
3: Uses simple language to effectively convey complex issues
Balances speaking with listening; encourages involvement of others
Utilizes chains of indirect influence and designs tactics to promote ideas
Responds positively and professionally to questions and challenges
4: Role models effective and persuasive communication strategies
Uses in-depth understanding of the person or organization to influence
Uses in-depth understanding of group dynamics to achieve objectives

core_competencies.name: Collaboration & Teamwork
core_competencies.definition: Communicating within and across groups to create alignment and share information.

1: Demonstrates respect for others and works productively with a broad range of individuals
Acts to promote the team, organization and its goals
Shares information and own expertise with others
Values and acknowledges the input and know-how of other team members
2: Communicates a clear vision of team goals and objectives
Creates an environment in which team members share both risks and rewards
Focuses the team's efforts on both the process and desired outcome
Acknowledges diverse views and works towards consensus-based solutions
3: Facilitates formation of cross-functional and cross-departmental teams
Demonstrates personal commitment to the maintenance of relationships
Encourages collaboration by constructing clear team objectives
Removes barriers and fosters collaboration across teams
4: Develops and fosters opportunities to enhance outcomes through partnerships and alliances
Encourages and negotiates sharing of information and skills across organization
Develops processes that give credit and recognition to teams
Drives a culture in which people are treated fairly and equitably

1.name: Adaptability
1.definition: Adjusting behaviors to work efficiently in light of new information or environments.
indicators: Seeks guidance in adapting behaviour to the needs of a new or different situation
Works actively in different work conditions, places, time and circumstances
Adheres to all Al Esraa's rules, systems, procedures and framework religiously

1.name: Punctuality & Accountability
1.definition: Responsibility for timeliness, commitment to tasks, and adherence to standards.
indicators: Follows rules and expectations for work attendance and performance
Provides advance notice of intended absence and/or Tardiness
Perseveres through various working conditions to complete tasks

1.name: Health & Safety Awareness
1.definition: Adherence to health and safety laws to maintain a safe work environment.
indicators: Carefully organizes the personal workspace to minimize the likelihood of an accident
Consistently adheres to detailed procedural instructions to carry out work activities safely

1.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
1.definition: Proactively taking action to address problems and achieve KPIs.
indicators: Is energetic and applies self to the task at hand
Demonstrates a 'can do' attitude to the delivery of KPI's
Accepts ambitious targets and invests energy to deliver these
Is committed to deadlines and timelines
Persists and adopts different approaches if initial attempts are not successful

2.name: Taking Initiative & Drive for Results
2.definition: Displays responsiveness and determination to complete the task to quality expectations.
indicators: Displays responsiveness and determination to complete the task to quality expectations
Constantly tries to improve own and/or the team's performance
Acts quickly and decisively in a time-sensitive situation
Monitors and measures key performance indicators, takes remedial action were required
Identifies future problems, communicates these and takes proactive steps
Shows willingness to work overtime in order to meet set deadlines

2.name: Continuous Learning
2.definition: Identifying strengths/weaknesses to enhance personal and team performance.
indicators: Continually self-assesses and seeks feedback from others to identify strengths and weaknesses
Consistently rely on himself in implementing self-development plans and actions
Pursues learning opportunities and on-going development
Takes advantage of learning opportunities (e.g., courses, observation of others, assignments)
Integrates new learning into work methods

2.name: Punctuality & Accountability
2.definition: Responsibility for timeliness, commitment to tasks, and adherence to standards.
indicators: Follow set procedures and rules
Takes appropriate measures to address group/team shortcomings
Shows willingness to work overtime in order to meet set deadlines

2.name: Health & Safety Awareness
2.definition: Adherence to health and safety laws to maintain a safe work environment.
indicators: Carefully organizes the personal workspace to minimize the likelihood of an accident
Consistently adheres to detailed procedural instructions to carry out work activities safely

3.name: Coaching & Leading Others
3.definition: Encouraging performance and fulfilling skill requirements of individuals and the organization.
indicators: Identifies or suggests activities that could help others develop new technical skills
Coaches others by providing feedback relative to learning new competencies
Reassures and/or expresses positive expectations for future performance
Generates excitement, enthusiasm and commitment in people
Leads by example; and aligns own behaviour with Al Esraa's vision and values

3.name: Supervision
3.definition: Overseeing team performance and ensuring adherence to organizational standards.
indicators: Provides on-going feedback and performance reviews on time
Supports the development of subordinates by providing ways and tools to improve their skills
Addresses team performance problems and issues promptly
Recognizes and encourages behaviours that contribute to teamwork

3.name: Initiation
3.definition: Starting new projects and driving organizational change and improvement.
indicators: Thinks ahead and effectively prepares and organizes resources and activities
Makes sure things aren't left to chance; ensures sufficient follow-up to check on progress
Anticipates and prepares for problems that may interfere with work or attainment of results

3.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
3.definition: Analyzing complex issues and making sound decisions based on available information.
indicators: Is able to consider information from multiple perspectives
Has the confidence to take decisions and be accountable for mistakes
Takes time to consider the short and long term outcomes and actions
Collaborates with the team to make sound decisions by gathering input and feedback

4.name: Results Orientation
4.definition: Focusing on achieving organizational goals and delivering measurable outcomes.
indicators: Guides staff to achieve smart objectives and performance standards
Evaluates others based on set and communicated KPIs
Focuses on agreed targets and pushes for improved results in area of responsibility
Takes on new roles and responsibilities when faced with unexpected changes

4.name: Problem Solving & Decision Making
4.definition: Analyzing complex issues and making sound decisions based on available information.
indicators: Demonstrates strategic thinking in problem-solving
Makes decisions that balance organizational objectives with stakeholder interests
Anticipates future challenges and develops preventive strategies
Leads complex decision-making processes involving multiple departments

4.name: Visioning & Strategic Thinking
4.definition: Developing and communicating a compelling vision for the future.
indicators: Articulates a clear and compelling vision for the organization's future
Thinks strategically about long-term organizational objectives
Aligns departmental goals with organizational strategy
Anticipates market trends and organizational needs

4.name: Conflict Management
indicators: Addresses conflicts directly and professionally
Seeks win-win solutions that satisfy all parties
Maintains composure and objectivity in difficult situations
Uses conflicts as opportunities for organizational learning and improvement
